Sydney Police Deploy Armed Officers After Bondi Attack

Sydney police have begun patrols with assault rifles in public spaces, sporting venues, and places of worship following the Bondi attack in December. The new Armed Response Command (ARC) is intended to provide "high visibility" patrols, marking an Australian first. The deployment is a direct response to the Bondi Beach attack.
